repos_data.description: Non-custodial Web3 settlement layer turning stablecoins into real-world utility payments (electricity, airtime, data, cable TV, education, bank transfers) for emerging markets on Celo & Base. An autonomous AI agent (ERC-8004 identity, 8004scan.io) pays bills unattended via Telegram/WhatsApp/X — bounded allowances, autopay, batch payments.
